title: Run the first real candidate end to end
work: Execute ingestion-backed tools, a real model assessment, MongoDB persistence and browser inspection.
done: The result can be independently checked from its exported inputs and calculations. This is the first complete vertical slice.

title: Run scientific correctness and honest-unknown journeys
work: Exercise numerical calculations, control interpretation, cell-context applicability and missing required evidence through the complete system.
done: Incorrect calculations fail evaluation and incomplete evidence cannot become a passing screen.

title: Exercise actual crash recovery
work: Kill the actual coordinator after acceptance but before checkpoint. Separately interrupt after budget reservation. Restart fresh processes.
done: Accepted outputs are preserved, unfinished work resumes and uncertain expenditure remains recorded.

title: Exercise revision during active work
work: Update a prepared evidence version while an affected task is running. Include two affected branches and an unrelated branch.
done: Stale acceptance fails, successors run, old results remain inspectable and unrelated work remains valid.

title: Exercise idempotency, invalid plans and budgets
work: Through real service paths, submit duplicate operations, conflicting duplicates, cyclic plans, unknown dependencies, prohibited patches and exhausted budgets.
done: Each fails or deduplicates correctly without corrupting the run. Produce inspectable operation/event records.

title: Exercise answer-key and tool-access isolation
work: Attempt evaluator-data access through the worker's available interfaces. Attempt unapproved tools and out-of-manifest artifacts.
done: Access is denied by actual boundaries, not merely by prompt instructions. The scored worker can still complete legitimate tasks.

title: Prove structural adaptation executes
work: Inspect a genuine automatic proposal, compiled architecture, executed role traces, validation result and subsequent selected-version run.
done: The saved change demonstrably affects execution. Deterministic adapters may test control paths but cannot establish actual model improvement.

title: Prove replay equals committed state
work: Start with an empty client, replay through a chosen watermark and compare the resulting entities with the backend snapshot.
done: Candidates, tasks, assessments, versions and totals agree. Repeated seeks remain deterministic.

title: Prove the genome zoom remains truthful
work: Select a real candidate, travel through all four zoom levels, inspect bases and return to overview. Repeat during replay at an older revision.
done: Genomic position, selected evidence and historical version remain consistent throughout the animation.

title: Exercise bounded context over accumulated history
work: Run enough legitimate intervening tasks or clearly labeled operational history to exercise retrieval of older evidence after restart.
done: The original objective and exact evidence remain accessible without loading the entire history. Report actual history/context sizes.

title: Produce the canonical real demonstration run
work: Generate a real recording-ready run, export its assets and author camera cues from its actual events. Measure duration and rehearse.
done: A fresh client can present the complete story, with explicit replay labeling and no invented outcomes.

title: Perform the final adversarial claim review
work: Compare the pitch against actual artifacts. Ask whether the agent made a consequential investigation decision, whether the harness changed, whether evaluation was fair and whether recovery was real.
done: Every spoken claim has evidence or is clearly framed as untested. Any missing improvement remains visible rather than rewritten into a success.
